newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Sunwear names Greg Weaver CEO.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Sunwear names Greg Weaver CEO.

text.p: Pacific Sunwear of California Inc said Wednesday that company president Greg Weaver had been named to the additional position of chief executive officer.
Weaver, 42, previously served as president and chief operating officer and has been with the company since 1987, the company said.
Since February 1996 he has also served as a director of the company.
No one from the company was available to say who Weaver succeeds.
A company spokesman later said the previous CEO Michael Rayden resigned in January to pursue other business interests.
